title: General customer comments and feature requests
summary: This topic combines broad owner satisfaction comments with a few specific complaints and requests, including touchscreen usability and desire for a frunk or separate sun-shade controls.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention overall satisfaction, repeat purchase confidence, comfort, and having no complaints about the vehicle.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe an issue arising shortly after purchase and difficulty using the touchscreen while driving, with limited detail in the sample.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include broad statements that the vehicle is fine or high quality, along with feature requests and incomplete comments that do not support a clear sentiment label.

limitations: The topic is loosely clustered and mixes general satisfaction statements, complaints, feature requests, and incomplete remarks rather than one clearly defined issue.
Most sampled fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confident interpretation of the dominant customer stance.
Several examples are vague or incomplete, so the sample does not provide enough detail to fully characterize the underlying concerns.
